description: Read-only. Recent conversion and revenue events (from the SDKs' track calls or record_event), newest first: name, value, currency, platform, the link and tap they are attributed to, and that tap's channel and campaign. Default: the last 7 days. Use it to check that purchases or sign-ups arrive. Reads the events export (an owner's or admin's key).

from.description: Inclusive start: 2026-10-01, an ISO date-time or epoch ms

slug.description: Only events attributed to this link

to.description: Exclusive end, same formats; default now

name: list_events
title: List recent events
